title: 第11章 暗影追踪第12章 双生情仇
lines: 雨雾压过皇城外环。
洛晖踩过破损蒸汽桥，桥面铁板被靴底踏得咔咔乱响。身后，十二只机械星纹鹰从钟塔顶端俯冲，黑钢羽片切开雨线，鹰眼里黑纹一圈圈收紧。
胸前铜星坠烫得钻心。
旧矿坑货单贴在内袋，纸页边缘已有发黑迹象。
洛晖抬手按住胸口，掌心蓝火隔着皮甲压下去。
“别急着烧掉，我还没看完你呢。”
三枚黑羽追踪钉从背后钉来。
洛晖侧身翻过桥栏，落到外环旧街的瓦砾坡上。追踪钉扎进桥面，黑钢纹顺着铁板爬开，桥头废灯同时亮起，形成一圈封路纹。
机械鹰腹部传声片亮起。
长夏的话从里面吐出：“洛晖，交出旧档。铁卫给你父亲案正式答案，也免你私闯货单库之罪。”
洛晖拔腿冲过一排废弃工坊，回头冲机械鹰竖起两根手指。
“正式答案？把人名涂黑，把活人写成货物，再盖个铁卫章？你们这公文写法，废墟镇收废纸的大爷看了都得退货。”
追在最前方的暗鹰校尉抬起星纹长弩。
他身披黑钢轻甲，左肩嵌着鹰眼追踪晶片。身后三名铁卫散开，手中封路弩同时上弦。
“活捉。夺回拍卖记录，回收旧矿坑货单。反抗者，按星痕走私重罪锁拿。”
洛晖听见“回收”二字，脚步一顿，随后更快。
“又回收？商会回收遗物，你们回收证据。曜都垃圾处理归你们两家承包了？”
弩箭钉入街口残墙。
黑钢网格铺开，压住地面星纹余波。
洛晖没有硬冲。他抬起左手，赤金尾戒在雨里转了半圈。戒面裂缝里，一缕赤金残纹断断续续泄出。
机械鹰鹰眼立刻转向，追踪核心从铜星坠移到尾戒。
洛晖低声道：“来，闻这个。奥格兄弟友情赞助，商会原味残凭。”
暗鹰校尉抬手，队形收束。
“目标借赤金残凭逃往黑市旧路。封左巷。”
洛晖拐进废墟之城。
这里没有皇城广场的星晶高台，只有残墙、裸露铜管、积水沟、坍塌棚架。旧矿坑排水渠入口半埋在泥里，远处废弃星纹灯塔断了半截，导能环歪在塔身上。
这片烂地，他闭着眼都能跑。
一处断墙阴影忽然张开。
绮雯抬手，暗影投射吞掉一枚贴近洛晖后颈的黑羽钉。钉身在暗影里挣扎两下，被她捏碎。
洛晖没停。
“第七章那笔定位账还没清。现在帮我，不代表我信你。”
绮雯把碎钉丢进水沟。
“暗鹰追踪会沿星纹余波反咬。跑得越快，尾迹越亮。”
“多谢提醒。友情提示也记账。”
她袖口下的暗星印记红了一下，暗影之刃刃心那缕蓝色净火跳动半息。她退回断墙后，没再同行。
前方，一只微光纸鹤穿过雨雾，落到洛晖指尖。
纸鹤燃尽，灰里浮出三处旧管线标记：旧矿坑排水渠、坍塌钟楼、废弃星纹灯塔。
绮兰没有现身。
洛晖看完，屈指弹开灰烬。
“绮大小姐真懂我，连坑都替我标好了。下次干脆附赠铲子，贵族服务再升级。”
身后机械鹰散成扇形封空。
content_en:
Rain and fog pressed across the outer ring of the imperial city.
Luo Hui stepped across the damaged steam bridge, and the iron plates of the bridge deck were rattled by the soles of his boots. Behind him, twelve mechanical star-patterned eagles swooped down from the top of the bell tower. The black steel feathers cut through the rain lines, and the black patterns in the eagle's eyes tightened.
The copper star pendant on her chest was very hot.
The old mine manifest is affixed to the inner pocket, and there are signs of blackening on the edges of the paper.
Luo Hui raised his hand to hold his chest, and the blue fire in his palm pressed down through the leather armor.
"Don't burn it in a hurry, I haven't finished reading you yet."
Three black feather tracking spikes were driven from behind.
Luo Hui turned sideways over the bridge railing and landed on the rubble slope of the outer ring old street. The tracking nails were driven into the bridge deck, and the black steel pattern crawled away along the iron plate. The waste lights at the bridge head lit up at the same time, forming a circle of road sealing patterns.
The sound piece on the mechanical eagle's belly lights up.
Chang Xia's words came out from inside: "Luo Hui, hand over the old files. Tie Wei will give you the official answer to the father's case, and you will be exempted from the crime of breaking into the cargo warehouse."
Luo Hui rushed through a row of abandoned workshops, turned back and raised two fingers at the mechanical eagle.
"The official answer? Black out the names of the people, write the living people as goods, and then stamp them with the Iron Guards seal? The way you write official documents will make the waste paper collector in Ruin Town return it after seeing it."
Captain Dark Eagle, who was chasing at the front, raised his star-patterned long crossbow.
He wore black steel light armor, with an eagle-eye tracking chip embedded in his left shoulder. The three iron guards behind him dispersed, and their road-sealing crossbows were cocked at the same time.
"Capture him alive. Seize the auction records and recover the old mine cargo list. Those who resist will be locked up according to the felony of smuggling in the star marks."
When Luo Hui heard the word "recycling", his steps paused, and then became faster.
"Recycle it again? The Chamber of Commerce recycles the relics, and you recycle the evidence. Is Yaodu's garbage disposal contracted by you two?"
Crossbow arrows were nailed into the remaining wall at the street entrance.
The black steel grid spread out, suppressing the aftermath of the star patterns on the ground.
Luo Hui did not rush forward. He raised his left hand, and the red gold tail ring spun half a circle in the rain. From the cracks on the ring surface, a wisp of red gold traces leaked out intermittently.
The mechanical eagle's eyes immediately turned, and the tracking core moved from the copper star pendant to the tail ring.
Luo Hui whispered: "Come and smell this. Friendly sponsorship from the Ogg brothers, and the original flavor of the Chamber of Commerce."
Captain Dark Eagle raised his hand and closed the formation.
"The target borrowed the red gold to escape to the old black market road. Seal the left lane."
Luo Hui turned into the ruined city.
There is no star-crystal platform like the Imperial City Square here, only broken walls, exposed copper pipes, stagnant ditches, and collapsed scaffolding. The entrance to the old mine drainage channel is half buried in the mud. In the distance, the abandoned star pattern lighthouse is half broken, and the energy guide ring is crooked on the tower.
He could run away from this rotten land with his eyes closed.
The shadow of a broken wall suddenly opened up.
Qiwen raised her hand, and the shadow cast swallowed a black feather nail close to the back of Luo Hui's neck. Nail struggled twice in the shadow and was crushed by her.
Luo Hui didn't stop.
"The positioning account in Chapter 7 has not been settled yet. Helping me now does not mean that I believe you."
Qiwen threw the broken nails into the ditch.
"The Dark Eagle's tracking will bite back along the star pattern's aftermath. The faster you run, the brighter the wake."
"Thanks for the reminder. Friendly reminder to keep accounts."
The Dark Star mark under her cuffs turned red, and the blue pure fire at the heart of the Shadow Blade pulsed for half a breath. She retreated behind the broken wall and did not go with him again.
Ahead, a shimmering paper crane passed through the rain and fog and landed on Luo Hui's fingertips.
The paper cranes burned out, and three old pipeline signs emerged from the ashes: the old mine drainage channel, the collapsed bell tower, and the abandoned star-patterned lighthouse.
Qilan did not show up.
After Luo Hui finished reading, he flicked away the ashes with his fingers.
"Miss Qi really understands me. She even marked the pits for me. Next time, I'll just give you a shovel and upgrade my noble service."
The mechanical eagles behind him spread out into a fan shape to seal the air.
title_en: Chapter 11 Shadow Pursuit Chapter 12 Twin Love and Enmity
